description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests for configuring WPS settings on WiFi access points, including enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, and pairing clients via pushbutton or PIN. It processes JSON configuration data from POST requests and updates device settings accordingly.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum for 4- or 8-digit PINs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies WPS settings to a specific SSID by applying device configuration commands.
